description_en: Enables the secure access proxy feature for a database instance
description_zh: 调用CreateProxy接口，开启实例的数据安全访问功能
name: CreateProxy

parameters.description_en: The ID of the database instance. You can call the [ListInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listinstances) or [GetInstance](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getinstance) operation to query the database instance ID.
